message.mod-stella-nether.chosen.normal: Stay in the portal to enter the normal nether.
message.mod-stella-nether.chosen.raid: Stay in the portal to enter the raid nether.
message.mod-stella-nether.host.normal.ho: Open the raid nether. Everyone inside holds one random boon.
message.mod-stella-nether.host.hard.hove: Open the raid nether. Everyone inside holds one boon; every raid mob holds two.
message.mod-stella-nether.join.hard.hove: Join the running raid nether. Its mobs hold two boons each.
message.mod-stella-nether.enraged: Thirty minutes have passed. The nether turns on you: run for the portal!
message.mod-stella-nether.portal_sealed: The portal stays shut. The sealed chest in this room wants a Blaze Core.
